environment.server: owned Pi Web development server from the task checkout

checks.name: desktop responsive default and independent pointer toggle
checks.evidence: Both widgets initially exposed native button controls with aria-expanded=true and distinct generated body IDs. A trusted mouse click collapsed only smoke-above, changed its label to Expand widget, and applied hidden to its still-present body while smoke-below remained expanded.

checks.name: native keyboard and visible focus
checks.evidence: The focused disclosure matched :focus-visible with a solid 2px outline. Trusted Enter expanded it and trusted Space collapsed it.

checks.name: collapsed live update and line cap
checks.evidence: While smoke-above remained hidden, an extension replacement delivered 11 authoritative lines. The mounted browser body updated through latest-10 plus the truncation marker and omitted latest-11; the agent state still reported 11 lines.

checks.name: placement, removal, and reappearance lifetime
checks.evidence: Moving smoke-above into the below-editor slot retained its explicit collapsed choice. Removing it and adding the same key again restored the untouched desktop default (expanded) in the above-editor slot.

checks.name: mobile defaults, touch, and viewport override stability
checks.evidence: At 390px both untouched widgets collapsed and each disclosure measured 44px high. A trusted synthesized touch tap expanded smoke-above; it remained expanded through mobile-to-desktop-to-mobile changes while untouched smoke-below followed the breakpoint and returned collapsed on mobile.

checks.name: mobile editor geometry
checks.evidence: The above widget region ended at y=620.5 before the textarea began at y=635.453125; the below region began at y=724 after the textarea ended at y=661.046875. The document had no horizontal overflow.

checks.name: browser runtime
checks.evidence: No Runtime.exceptionThrown events or browser error log entries were observed during the final run.
